widget.title: Widget
widget.intro: Style the tip button and copy the snippet into your own site.
widget.generateHint: Go to the Payments page first: add your site address and complete the first setup step.
widget.positionHint: Where the button sits on the page.
widget.colorHint: Pick a preset or enter your own hex value.
widget.fontHint: Typeface for the button label. Inherit from page uses the font your site already loads.
widget.iconHint: Pick a symbol or type your own.
widget.headline: Headline
widget.headlineHint: Shown on the button next to the icon. Leave empty for an icon-only button.
widget.bodyHint: Turns the button into a card with this text and a Tip button.
widget.actionLabelHint: Text on the card's button. Only used when a body is set.
widget.closeEnabledHint: Show the control visitors can use to hide the widget.
widget.previewHint: A mock page showing where the button lands.
widget.embedIntro: Paste this just before the closing body tag on every page that should show the button.
